Wellness Rewards
FAB 25 Rewards for every 1,000 daily steps you take using STEPPI

Along with your FAB Rewards Active credit card you will receive a fitness payment ring, provided free for life and issued once per primary cardholder. The ring is uniquely linked to your card and enables contactless payments on the go. Simply download Tappy Pay via the FAB Mobile app to register your ring. Your health and fitness data can be accessed and reviewed within the Tappy app. Learn more
Earn FAB Rewards for every 1,000 daily steps you take
Earn 25 FAB Rewards for every 1,000 steps using STEPPI with the FAB Mobile App when you achieve a minimum of 6,000 steps per day. Rewards are capped at a maximum of 10,000 steps per day. Learn more
Up to 20% off for online purchases at Sun & Sand Sports

Keep up with your fitness and enjoy free access to gyms and fitness classes across the UAE and much more with your ADV+ complimentary membership.* Gain access through the Adv+ website using your unique voucher code, which will be sent to you within one month from the card activation date. Explore some of the best attractions around with an unlimited discount of up to 50% at Wild Wadi, Dubai Parks and Resorts, tour Inside Burj Al Arab, The Green Planet and The View Palm. Learn more
Enjoy a discount of up to 20% on Talabat
Take advantage of up to 20% off on one food or grocery delivery each month through the Talabat app using the promo code MASTERCARD. Learn more
Free global airport lounge access
Enhance your travel experience with free access to over 25 airport lounges across the globe 4 times a year when you spend just USD 1 on the card. Learn more
